entrypoint.details: The decoding function processes externally provided encoded session data, serving as the initial point for untrusted input handling.

precondition.details: The vulnerability requires an attacker to supply a maliciously crafted encoded string as session data to the decoding function.

root_cause.details: The original implementation directly instantiates a standard deserialization stream to reconstruct objects from input bytes without validating or restricting the types of objects being reconstructed.

fix_intent.details: The patch replaces the standard deserialization stream with a whitelist-based mechanism to restrict which classes can be deserialized, thereby preventing arbitrary object instantiation.

derived_fields.pattern.disproven_when: derived verification condition based on FI; not a claim about target code
